meta.title: CommandIt — Library Architecture
meta.subtitle: Hexagonal command bus: ports in, vendor-neutral, RunIt-agnostic

cards.title: Lifecycle (one execution per command)
items: DEFINED → validate(name, required input)
RECEIVED — occurrence: CommandReceived
EXECUTING — activity begins; monotonic duration_ms starts
SUCCEEDED — occurrence: CommandHandled, snapshot: CommandResult
FAILED — occurrence: CommandFailed, original Throwable preserved
CANCELLED — reserved in CommandStatus; not wired (no CancellationPort yet)

cards.title: Port contracts (src/Contract/Port)
items: ClockInterface, IdentifierGeneratorInterface
ExecutionContextProviderInterface, ContextTokenInterface
ExecutionReporterInterface (ISP-split into LifecycleReporterInterface)
CommandExecutionStorageInterface
RuntimeContextDetectorInterface (Fiber / coroutine detection)
SerializerInterface, RedactionPolicyInterface
Used by both executor (now(), id(), serialize) and coordinator (duration_ms)

cards.title: Default concrete adapters (src/Adapter/*)
items: SystemClock, RandomIdentifierGenerator
AmbientContextStorage / FiberBoundContextStorage (WeakMap, no process globals)
CollectingExecutionReporter + RedactingExecutionReporter + GuardedExecutionReporter + SafeReporterFactory
InMemoryCommandExecutionStorage (bounded, FIFO eviction)
SafeSerializer (cycle + depth guards, no arbitrary object serialization)
ArgvInputParser, ConsoleCommandBridge, ConsoleCommandRegistry (Symfony optional)

cards.title: Security & redaction defaults
items: Context values are classified; secrets are never exported
RedactionPolicy + redaction markers redact before publication
Bounded buffers, overflow policy, recursion guard (per-Fiber WeakMap)
Arbitrary object serialization is prohibited; max depth + cycle detection
Original business exception is always rethrown on failure

cards.title: Optional external ecosystem (adapters, not deps)
items: symfony/console — CLI projection via Adapter/CLI (suggest, not required)
psr/log, psr/event-dispatcher — adapter surface, not a core contract
psr/clock — ClockInterface has a bring-your-own PSR-20 adapter
it-pack/command-it-run-it — future RunIt pipeline via ports only
Core imports zero Symfony / RunIt / PSR types (DepTrac 0 violations)
